title: Butcher’s son
html_source:
John Aubrey, in Lives of Eminent Men (1696), set out the idea Shakespeare was a butcher’s son. This, however, is not substantiated by records.

His experiences are contributing to the composition of the play. His butchering days allowed him to write act five.
